goal: Stop a pull request from judging itself by loosening a criterion's probe and checking its box in the same diff, by making that visible on the pull request (roadmap R29, unit 2).
changed: check-product.py --base REF compares each box the branch newly checked with REF. A criterion whose Probe: text changed, or that REF doesn't have, prints an `observe:` line unless the item gains a **Confirmed.** line it didn't have at REF. The exit code never changes.
--receipts makes the same comparison against its base. --base alone used to be a usage error; it now runs this check without receipts.
A **Confirmed.** line in an item no longer counts as part of the criterion's claim, so confirming a probe after its receipt doesn't make the receipt stale.
The Product phase playbook, the scaffold-product layout reference and the gate table in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md say so.

claims.claim: A fixture branch that rewrites C1's probe to `true`, takes a receipt and checks the box passed silently on origin/main and now prints one observe: line naming P1-C1, still exiting 0; with a new **Confirmed.** line on the item it prints nothing.
